The Home Buying Process

From pre-approval to keys in hand, here's what to expect when you finance with us.

1

Get Pre-Approved

Know exactly how much you can afford before you start shopping. Our quick pre-approval process gives you confidence and credibility with sellers.

2

Find Your Home

Work with your real estate agent to find the perfect property. We can connect you with trusted local agents if needed.

3

Make an Offer

With your pre-approval in hand, submit a competitive offer. We'll provide the documentation needed to strengthen your position.

4

Process Your Loan

We handle the paperwork, appraisal, and underwriting. You'll have a dedicated loan officer guiding you through each step.

5

Close & Get Keys

Sign your documents and receive the keys to your new home. We make closing day smooth and stress-free.
